evidence.text: Matters is developing an AI-powered consumer banking platform to help users manage spending, increase savings and improve financial wellbeing through personalised guidance and a subscription-based model.

Matters What Matters. Hi. We’re Matters, a company based in Stockholm, working globally. We’re building the next generation of banking with the vision to make financial wellbeing and wealth available to anyone. If you’d like to join us in building world-class products for millions of people, we’d love to hear from you. Visit matters.inc/jobs , reach out at hi@matters.inc , and follow along on LinkedIn .
